title: Nodding without understanding
literal_meaning: Nod the head like a lizard.
explanation: A person keeps signalling agreement whether or not they understand what is being said. The source’s gloss makes the gap between the nod and comprehension explicit. The expression can tease empty assent or call attention to it when a real decision requires understanding.
meaning_odia: କଥା ବୁଝିବା ନ ବୁଝିବା ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ ଖାଲି ମୁଣ୍ଡ ହଲାଇ ସମ୍ମତି ଦେବା।
usage_example: After a complicated explanation, a listener nods along but cannot say what they have agreed to do. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The animal comparison belongs to the figurative expression. The entry makes no zoological claim about why a lizard moves its head.
